verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair axis for a domain registrar, but the evidence never documents exporting account, domain or DNS data in open formats, nor transferring domains out to leave. The general API and MCP read actions ('view your domains and account info') are only building blocks a developer could use to construct an export, and the only transfer evidence covers moving domains in to Dynadot.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
